catalog.name: Capstone synthetic test identity catalog
catalog.source_note: Manually curated pilot metadata for the supplied MS-PNT-410 sample, not an authoritative standards database. Chinese aliases are demonstration terminology. Editions are unknown; method associations do not imply equivalence. Customer procedures are labeled separately from formal standard identifiers. Fluid names are not global test aliases; family mapping also requires the source chemical/fluid section and its stated procedure or conditions. The four explicitly fictional CSP-EN-301 methods retain their source-stated editions and are not equivalent to earlier catalog methods. No standard body text or lab capability claims are included. The data team's synthetic bank adds all 71 family names and 77 explicitly selected method identities; full 32,000-row metadata is separately queryable and is not sent wholesale to a model. Exact pilot IDs are retained. Bank metadata does not populate any lab declaration or establish method equivalence. Source CSV SHA-256: c66684bdea3df054b792ade15100a83208da06f95750b6d8dfc588a4720c6a91.
